commands.summary: Plan and execute the create campaign reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create campaign apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new campaign targeting the given lists/segments; depending on Options this may schedule a live send to real recipients, not a preview-only action
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: adds a new contact to the account's overall recipient list; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create domain reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create domain apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers a new sending domain pending DNS verification; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create inbound route reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create inbound route apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new inbound-mail routing rule that forwards matching inbound email to an external address or webhook URL of the caller's choosing
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new contact list, optionally seeding it from existing contact emails; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create segment reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create segment apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new dynamic contact segment from a SQL-like rule; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create template reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create template apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new email template; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail create webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers a new outbound webhook that will POST live event data (sent/opened/clicked/bounced) to an external URL of the caller's choosing; verify the target endpoint before enabling
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete campaign reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete campaign apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a campaign; if it has not finished sending, any remaining scheduled deliveries are cancelled
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a contact and its activity/consent history from the account
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete domain reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete domain apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a verified sending domain; any campaign configured to send from this domain will fail until reconfigured
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete inbound route reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete inbound route apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes an inbound-mail routing rule; matching inbound mail is no longer forwarded once removed
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a contact list; any campaign still targeting this list by name will fail to resolve its recipients
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete segment reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete segment apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a segment; any campaign still targeting this segment by name will fail to resolve its recipients
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete template reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete template apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a template; any campaign still referencing this template by name will fail to build its content
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail delete webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a webhook subscription; event delivery to its target URL stops immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing contact's status/name/custom-field data; a Status change (e.g. to Unsubscribed) changes future campaign eligibility for this recipient
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update inbound route reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update inbound route apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing inbound route's match filter or forwarding destination; redirects future matching inbound mail to a different address/URL
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames an existing list or changes its unsubscribe-allowed setting; a rename changes the identifier campaigns/segments reference this list by
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update segment reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update segment apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: changes the membership rule of an existing segment; immediately changes which contacts any campaign targeting this segment will reach
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update template reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update template apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: overwrites the subject/body of an existing template; any campaign referencing this template by name sends the new content on its next send
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm elasticemail update webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing webhook's target URL or event subscriptions; a changed URL redirects future event deliveries to a different endpoint
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm elasticemail webhooks list --json
